finalYaml:
parameters:
- name: entries
  type: object
  default:
    FIRST: one
    SECOND: two
variables:
- name: BASE
  value: base
- name: FIRST
  value: one
- name: SECOND
  value: two
stages:
- stage: probe
  jobs:
  - job: probe
    steps:
    - task: CmdLine@2
      inputs:
        script: echo $(BASE)-$(FIRST)-$(SECOND)
